root_cause.text: The driver incorrectly released a reference to the device_node (dn) owned by the device model (PCI core) via of_node_put(), causing premature freeing and subsequent use of the freed pointer in of_platform_default_populate().
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the erroneous of_node_put(dn) call; the CVE description states that the reference owned by the PCI core should not be released by the driver, and the freed dn is later passed to of_platform_default_populate(), leading to use-after-free.
